name: t23-g3-join-budget
description: T23 / G3 row 11 join budget. Three live clients run the same separated-regions west/east multi-region collapse workload as t23-g3 (client 0 severs the west column, client 1 severs the east column, then all three excavate each region's floor ends) so the world carries a real, non-trivial, dependency-complete edit history before anyone joins late. After that workload quiesces and both beams settle, client 3 connects as a --late-join replica through a shaped proxy imposing the docs/validation.md G3 join-budget network profile: 1 MiB/s bandwidth, 100 ms RTT, 20 ms jitter, 2% packet loss. The harness measures the compressed byte size of the baseline transfer actually sent over the wire and the wall-clock time from connect to ready (baseline installed, catch-up queue drained, first post-baseline motion keyframe observed) and asserts both against the gate budget: <=16 MiB compressed, <=30 s to ready. The live clients and server run on transparent (unshaped) proxies so the workload phase is not itself bandwidth-limited. See docs/reports/G3.md.
